headline: Retail sales growth cools

primary_source.title: Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services, October 2026

reporting_source.title: Retail spending slowed in October as high prices gave shoppers pause
reporting_source.author: Anne D’Innocenzio

data.label: September revised sales; reported monthly growth unchanged at +0.8%

interpretation: Point estimate of monthly retail-sales growth eased. October change is not statistically distinguishable from zero at 90% confidence. Do not infer consumer collapse or declining inflation-adjusted spending.
visualization: Two large numeric month panels, not a reconstructed source chart. Equal panel size conveys labels only, not data magnitude.
as_of: Primary release November 17, 2026; edition date November 18, 2026; October observation.
